output.reason: [ev-32984cccce52] says the three metallb-bgp flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` were removed. So the exposed environments are the ones that still set any of them. The proposed condition matches any environment that sets one of these flags, either as a container argument or as a key in the cilium-config ConfigMap. That fits the canonical shape for a removed flag (`cli-flag{name, set}`). Listing three flags in one entry does not stop us from writing a precise condition, because an `any` over the three flags covers exactly the exposed environments.
